entities.name: Temasek and the Singapura Legend

entities.summary: The island known as Temasek ('Sea Town'), the legendary founding of Singapura by Sri Tri Buana (Sang Nila Utama) and the sighting of a lion, and its role as a minor trading port under Srivijayan influence.
